decision.rationale: TXN-007870 (5802 EUR cents, OAKHOLLOW CHEMIST, MER-000049) is on card CRD-000235. It posted on 2026-08-21 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-28. That is 68 days, inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. Its authorisation AUTH-008082 shows entry mode CHIP, PIN verified true, 3-D Secure NOT_APPLICABLE, response APPROVED and fraud flag false. So the physical card and the correct PIN were both used. Policy unauthorised-chip-and-pin treats this as a payment made by the cardholder and requires a decline. Two earlier approved purchases at the same merchant on this card support that: TXN-007869 on 2026-07-17 for 40.13 EUR and TXN-007868 on 2026-07-10 for 23.77 EUR. The cardholder says they kept the card the whole time, which fits a chip-and-PIN payment. It does not show that someone else made it.

proposed_actions.reason: We are closing this dispute. The 58.02 EUR payment to OAKHOLLOW CHEMIST on 2026-08-20 was made in person with your card's chip, and the correct PIN was entered. Our records show no signs of fraud. You have also made earlier purchases at this merchant with the same card.
